name: How can I prevent sewage from entering my crawl space?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent sewage from entering my crawl space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing sewage in your crawl space involves regular plumbing maintenance and awareness of potential issues. Avoid flushing non-biodegradable items, ensure your main sewer line is free of tree root intrusions through periodic inspections, and repair any leaky pipes promptly. Consider installing a backwater valve to prevent sewage from backing up into your home during city sewer line issues. Maintaining proper yard drainage can also mitigate risks from heavy rainfall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preventative measures include regular plumbing maintenance, avoiding flushing non-biodegradables, inspecting sewer lines for roots, and installing backwater valves.
